diff --git a/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts b/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
index 95c62f2..209e69a 100644
--- a/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
+++ b/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
@@ -131,6 +131,33 @@ export function haveSameId(entity1: SomeEntity, entity2: SomeEntity): boolean {
 	return isSameId(entity1._id, entity2._id)
 }
 
+/**
+ * Removes encryption and error metadata from a new entity, including its nested objects.
+ * The mutated entity must not be used for an update operation.
+ */
+export function removeTechnicalFields<E extends SomeEntity>(entity: E): void {
+	const visited = new WeakSet<object>()
+
+	function removeFrom(object: object): void {
+		if (visited.has(object)) return
+		visited.add(object)
+
+		const fields = object as Record<string, unknown>
+		for (const key of Object.keys(fields)) {
+			if (key.startsWith("_finalEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_defaultEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_errors")) {
+				delete fields[key]
+			} else {
+				const value = fields[key]
+				if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
+					removeFrom(value)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	removeFrom(entity)
+}
+
 export function containsId(ids: ReadonlyArray<Id | IdTuple>, id: Id | IdTuple): boolean {
 	return ids.find((idInArray) => isSameId(idInArray, id)) != null
 }
